node.title: Re^5: I match a pattern in regex, yet I don't get the group I wanted to extract for some reason
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
See [mod://Mojo::DOM::CSS] for the selectors supported by [mod://Mojo::DOM]; these are based on CSS selectors, which you can learn more about at various places on the Internet, for example [https://www.w3schools.com/css/css_selectors.asp] (though Mojo only supports a subset). Unfortunately, checking the text content of elements isn't something they can do, but you can still use the other methods in [mod://Mojo::DOM] and [mod://Mojo::Collection] to get what you want. So just for example, given your example input, the following code prints "11 December 2020".

$dom->find('.release-date-item') ->grep(sub { $_->at('.release-date-item__country-name') ->all_text =~ /^\s*USA\s*$/ }) ->each(sub { print $_->at('.release-date-item__date') ->all_text, "\n" });

Update: To clarify: It's ok that I'm using a regular expression here because I'm matching against the return value of ->all_text, which is just getting the plain-text content of the tags; I'm not trying to parse the tags themselves with the regex - [mod://Mojo::DOM] has done that for us.
